newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Hanil Leasing buying back shares.
newsitem.headline: Hanil Leasing buying back shares.

text.p: South Korea's Hanil Leasing Co Ltd said on Thursday it would buy back 429,000 common shares on the open market from December 2 to March 1 to boost the group's share price.
The buyback represents three percent of Hanil's share capital, a company statement said.
The company currently holds none of its own shares.

The statement said the shares would be bought at the previous day's closing price. Dongwon Securities, Hanil Securities, LG Securities, Daewoo Securities and Daishin Securities will handle the buyback.
Hanil's shares closed 60 won higher at 7,560 on Thursday.
